notes: Complete name and objective lists exist only for Hirschfelden and Layton Lake District. Cuatro Colinas, Emerald Coast Australia, Askiy Ridge and Intisuyu have full name lists rebuilt from TacMaps URL slugs, without objectives. For the other reserves, the file gives mission givers and arcs (from achievements), official mission counts and the few mission names that could be confirmed. Mission rewards (XP and cash) are not listed in any source that could be reached. The fandom wiki, which has full lists, is blocked here. Part A (Medved-Taiga, Vurhonga Savanna, Parque Fernando, Yukon Valley, Silver Ridge Peaks, Te Awaroa, Rancho del Arroyo, Mississippi Acres, Revontuli Coast). Full arcs with objectives were found only for Vurhonga Savanna (Ospreay, Maritz, Mboweni) and Yukon Valley (Kayla Johnson), from TrueAchievements solutions, which are paraphrased by players, so wording may differ slightly from the in-game text. Distances in those solutions were in yards; the metre values in brackets are conversions (82.1 yd = 75 m, 38.29 yd = 35 m). No source gave mission rewards (XP, cash or items), so every reward is null. TacMaps mission pages are client-rendered and its sitemap could only be read up to Layton Lake, the fandom wiki is blocked, and most TrueAchievements arc pages refused the fetch. Part B of missions.json: complete replacement entries for New England Mountains, Sundarpatan, Salzwiesen Park, Tòrr nan Sìthean, Cuatro Colinas, Emerald Coast Australia, Askiy Ridge and Intisuyu. Objectives mostly come from the Japanese community wiki (atwiki) and are translated, so their wording differs from the in-game English text. English mission names come from TacMaps URL slugs, Wand, patch notes, Steam threads and mission video titles, matched to the Japanese entries by meaning (or by elimination where noted). Where no English name was found, 'name' is null and 'nameJa'/'nameTranslated' hold the Japanese name and an unofficial translation. Extra per-mission fields: nameJa, nameTranslated, unlock, slug, notes. No reachable source lists XP or cash rewards, so these are null throughout; reward.items is set only where a source names an item.
